description: Owner-controlled black-box acceptance journeys (adversarial audit R3). Every assertion is bound to approved requirement IDs; none adds product behaviour. priority P0 fails the journey; P1 and ODR-pending assertions are recorded and reported but do not fail it (UI-009 is P1; the WASM-LOAD P0 subset is owner decision ODR-R10-08). The builder cannot edit these files: they run from the governed Indy-init checkout.
accessibleNames: Fields and actions are found by the catalog's names (CAT-CAUSA-INVESTIGATION name fields) and by the requirement-named destinations and sections. The connection form is found by role and label pattern (owner, repository, branch, token|credential) because no requirement fixes those labels; the pattern list is owner decision ODR-R10-07.

assertions.check: a fresh launch shows a disconnected workspace with an explicit Connect data repository action
connecting to the designated test repository shows its investigations
an investigation with a problem statement, title and question is started
Save reaches Saved, and Saved is shown only after the commit exists on GitHub
GitHub itself (read by the journey, not the app) holds every entered value
a fresh browser context lists the investigation, opens it, and shows its identity and content
an observation with a source reference is recorded
two hypotheses are recorded and listed
two evidence items are recorded
evidence is linked to a hypothesis as supports and as contradicts, each with a rationale
each link is shown from the evidence view and from the hypothesis view
reassessing a link changes its kind and keeps the earlier assessment in the history
a conclusion is recorded
Overview, Causal Analysis, Evidence, Hypotheses and Timeline each open and show this investigation's content; Causal Analysis lists the relationships
after Save and a reload in a fresh context every value, link and the reassessment history persist
a report of the investigation renders and has a print presentation
Investigations, Administration and Settings are persistent primary destinations; each opens and marks itself current
Administration shows the provider and repository; Settings shows preferences
an edit makes the state Unsaved
going offline with unsaved changes shows Offline and keeps the values; coming back shows Unsaved
a second writer's save shows Conflict and keeps that tab's values
a provider refusal shows Save failed and keeps the values
a lost answer after a write is sent shows Unknown commit outcome, never Saved
the primary navigation is reachable and operable by keyboard with visible focus
at 390 px the shell and workspace have no horizontal overflow
while the application loads, a visible status says it is loading
